decision_basis: All 30 candidate masks were visually usable (23 good, 7 partial, 0 poor), while only 16/30 candidate regions had direct semantic correspondence and 6/30 contradicted the family interpretation. All 12 hard negatives had good masks and coherent visual appearance, yet every one required a narrower claim because similarity came from labels, screen content, pictorial content, or scene composition. The bottleneck is correspondence and interpretation, not mask generation.
claim_limit: This targeted audit estimates mechanism failure modes for selected high-interest and known negative families; it is not a prevalence estimate over all 129 families.
